topic: delinquency and unit-turn workflows for self-storage facilities

products.name: Delinquency Promise Board
products.product: A focused self-storage delinquency follow-up tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent self-storage facilities and small multi-site operators
products.problem: Payment reminders, tenant promises, access changes, policy milestones, and manager exceptions are recorded in different places, making the next compliant action hard to see.
products.valueProposition: Turns self-storage delinquency follow-up tracking into a visible operating queue so every delinquent account has a policy-based next action, documented tenant response, and verified stop condition.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets self storage delinquency tracker, storage tenant payment follow up, self storage collections workflow, and storage promise to pay searches.

products.name: Unit Turn Readiness
products.product: A focused self-storage move-out inspection and unit turn tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent self-storage facilities and small multi-site operators
products.problem: A vacated unit can remain unrentable because final access, inspection, cleaning, damage, billing, and availability updates do not close as one workflow.
products.valueProposition: Turns self-storage move-out inspection and unit turn tracking into a visible operating queue so every vacated unit is inspected, cleared, reconciled, and published as rentable or held with a named reason.
products.topic: self-storage move-out inspection and unit turn tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets self storage unit turnover, storage move out inspection, vacant unit readiness, and storage unit cleaning checklist searches.
